_about: John William Donaldson (1811-1861): The Theatre of the Greeks, a treatise on the history and exhibition of the Greek drama, seventh edition, revised, enlarged and in part remodelled (London: Longman and others, 1860), raw IA OCR at 0.781, just over the bar. IA also holds earlier forms of the book (1830, catalogued with P. W. Buckham; 1836); the 1860 seventh edition is taken as Donaldson's own revised treatise. He continued K. O. Müller's literary history (k-o-muller shelf). Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics). No uids minted.
